title: equisetum palustre f. tenue
intro: Equisetum palustre f. tenue, commonly known as marsh horsetail, is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the Equisetaceae family. It is a perennial herb that grows in wetlands and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support kidney function, reduce inflammation, and lower blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of marsh horsetail include diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids. These constituents may help to protect against oxidative stress, improve cardiovascular health, and modulate immune responses, making marsh horsetail a valuable medicinal plant.
